properties.name: BASELINE (measured 2026-09-29, installed 0.74.0 release, isolated): reflow2's own design (5,928 nodes, ~108,400 facts) cold-opens in ~1.25 s using ~54 MB over the empty store, about 520 bytes per fact. A rebuild from its export takes ~7 s; open plus a full detect_gaps ~4.2 s. Token-side baseline from the same exercise: ~610 designer calls over 3 rounds, ~290 KB echoed for ~40 KB of edits, 120 KB of describe payloads for 41 tools
properties.statement:
From art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29 (Measured baselines, and items I4/I6), for this requirement's "budgets written before any optimisation".

TIME AND MEMORY. Measured by the DESIGNER AGENT of the two-agent exercise, not re-run in this triage: a copy of docs/design/reflow2.json in a scratch directory, the installed 0.74.0 release binary via --call / --graph-path, scratch HOME confirmed empty afterwards.
- Cold open: about 1.25 s, and about 54 MB above the empty-store baseline, so roughly 520 bytes per asserted fact. This is the number req:one-open-design-costs-a-deliberate-amount-of-memory asks to be chosen rather than inherited.
- Rebuild of the store from the export: about 7 s.
- Open plus one full detect_gaps: about 4.2 s.

TOKENS PER TASK, from the same exercise:
- The designer made about 610 tool calls over 3 rounds of one design task.
- About 290 KB of replies echoed back for about 40 KB of edits (the designer's estimate).
- The describe payloads for the 41 tools the designer had to look up come to 120,363 characters (average 2,935; add_constraint 7,541), MEASURED by this triage from 0.74.0's tools/list.
The per-call echo sizes are in fact:root-cause-a-write-replies-with-the-whole-stored-node-and-replace-text-adds-each-prior-field-2026-09-29.

Use: the "before" column for req:the-mcp-surface-is-sized-for-tokens-per-task and req:the-graph-engine-keeps-a-compact-index-per-primitive. The same exercise will be re-run on fixed versions as an after-test.

Bounds: one design, one machine, single runs, no variance measured. The 520 B/fact figure is divided by the ASSERTED facts, and derived facts are not counted.
